marisol (CS): quick heads-up — this morning ~08:12 UTC we saw auth timeouts impacting final indexing for 12 priority onboarders (EU + US regions). Affected flows: SSO callback -> ingest -> index finalize. Some tenants saw repeated 502s from the indexing worker. We need a short customer-facing status, mitigation steps, and to flag renewal risk for any accounts with active trials.

ajay (Eng): can you paste the mini postmortem summary? severity, root cause hypothesis, and whether a rollback is in play?

marisol (CS): severity = P2 for onboarding (blocks activation for ~2–12 tenants). Root cause: a new batching change in the indexing worker caused a race when SSO metadata is missing; triggers an uncaught 502. Ops already throttled that worker at 08:30 UTC. We've queued a hotfix to add checks + guardrail. No rollback needed; we're patching and will roll forward once tests pass.

darren (Ops): mitigation timeline: 08:30 throttle + auto-retry enabled; 08:45 transient queue drained for 9/12 tenants; 09:10 deploy attempt failed CI; re-run started 09:28; 09:45 deploy passed to canary (US), 09:55 applied to EU. We saw success for 11/12 after the EU canary. One tenant still in manual retry due to custom webhook failures.

sophie (CS): OK — drafting customer note. Keeping it concise, empathetic, and offering office hours + credits. Draft below — please react with :thumbsup: to approve or suggest edits.

sophie (CS): ```Hello <Customer>,

We’re reaching out with an update about an issue that affected part of our onboarding process earlier today. Between 08:10–09:30 UTC, a bug in our indexing pipeline caused some finalization steps for a small number of new accounts to fail, which may have prevented activation or caused repeated errors.

What we’ve done: patched the pipeline, retried queued jobs, and confirmed successful activation for most affected accounts. We continue to work with the one remaining account to finish manual retries.

Next steps: we’ve implemented a guardrail to prevent recurrence, run a targeted validation for affected tenants, and scheduled office hours this week for hands-on help. We’re also offering a one-time onboarding credit; your CS rep will follow up with details.

If you experienced any disruption, please reply to this message or book time with us: <booking link>.

Apologies for the inconvenience — we appreciate your patience.

Best,
The Redwood Onboarding Team```

marisol (CS): this reads well. Add a one-line TL;DR at the top and a brief note about "no data loss". Also add a deadline for the credit claim (30 days).

ajay (Eng): can we include a short technical appendix link for customers who are curious? e.g., a public post confirming cause + low-level mitigation timeline. If so, sophie pls add placeholder link.

sophie (CS): updated draft with TL;DR and "no data loss" line and placeholder link. New snippet: ```TL;DR: A transient bug paused final onboarding indexing for a small set of accounts; most restored automatically, no data lost. Full details: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1960012345```

darren (Ops): verification notes for CS: affected tenants list (internal): tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c, tenant-d, tenant-e, tenant-f, tenant-g, tenant-h, tenant-i, tenant-j, tenant-k, tenant-l. tenant-g requires manual retry due to outbound webhook errors. ETA for final manual recovery: 2–4 hours depending on customer webhook responsiveness.

marisol (CS): thanks — i'm going to split outreach: 1) immediate personalized DM for the 3 highest-risk renewal trials (tenant-a, tenant-d, tenant-j) with offer + exec contact; 2) bulk email for the rest with the above note + booking link; 3) follow-up checklist for onboarders who still show failed indexing.

ajay (Eng): renewal risk flagging: put tenant-a & tenant-d into "at-risk" in CRM and schedule a check-in within 24 hours. If they don't activate within 72 hours, initiate renewal outreach program.

sophie (CS): I'll own the credit issuance flow and the office hours calendar. marisol, can you confirm the exec contact for tenant-a?

marisol (CS): exec = nina-evans, cc: sean-cto. I'll send personalized notes to tenant-a/d/j in next 20 minutes and paste each DM here.

incident-bot: [automated] Incident 1960012345 created — link: https://internal.incidents/1960012345 — status: investigating -> mitigated (partial).

darren (Ops): post-deploy action items: add null-check to SSO metadata, add unit + integration test for missing metadata path, and add a metric + alert for indexing worker 5xx spike. I can PR the changes today.

marisol (CS): final asks before we send: ajay — confirm no outstanding migration or data-loss notes. darren — confirm ETA to merge into main. sophie — final draft to send within 30 min.

ajay (Eng): confirmed no data loss. All affected payloads were retried from durable queue.

darren (Ops): PR created, review requested. ETA to merge + deploy to prod: ~90 minutes from now (depends on review).

sophie (CS): sending bulk customer note now (template above) and DMing high-touch tenants. Will paste copies when sent.

marisol (CS): thank you team. After outreach, please capture customer replies in the shared spreadsheet and add any signal for renewal risk/feedback. We'll run a short sync in 1.5 hours to review outstanding manual recoveries and any escalations. :white_check_mark:
